verses.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.pt: De novo veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
verses.pt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra os filhos de Amom, e profetiza contra eles.
verses.en_web: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, let your face be turned to the children of Ammon, and be a prophet against them:

verses.en: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
verses.pt: E dize aos amonitas: Ouvi a palavra do Senhor Deus: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Visto que tu disseste: Ah! contra o meu santuário quando foi profanado, e contra a terra de Israel quando foi assolada, e contra a casa de Judá quando foi para o cativeiro;
verses.en_web: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was made desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity:
verses.en_bbe: And say to the children of Ammon, Give ear to the word of the Lord; this is what the Lord has said: Because you said, Aha! against my holy place when it was made unclean, and against the land of Israel when it was made waste, and against the people of Judah when they were taken away as prisoners;

verses.en: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
verses.pt: por isso eis que te entregarei em possessão ao povo do Oriente, e em ti estabelecerão os seus acampamentos, e porão em ti as suas moradas. Eles comerão os teus frutos, e beberão o teu leite.
verses.en_web: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you, and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I will give you up to the children of the east for their heritage, and they will put their tent-circles in you and make their houses in you; they will take your fruit for their food and your milk for their drink.

verses.en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.pt: E farei de Rabá uma estrebaria de camelos, e dos amonitas um curral de rebanhos; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will make Rabbah a place for housing camels, and the children of Ammon a resting-place for flocks: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
verses.pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor Deus: Visto como bateste com as mãos, e pateaste com os pés, e te alegraste com todo o despeito do teu coração contra a terra de Israel;
verses.en_web: For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel;
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord has said, Because you have made sounds of joy with your hands, stamping your feet, and have been glad, putting shame with all your soul on the land of Israel;

verses.en: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.pt: portanto eis que eu tenho estendido a minha mão contra ti, e te darei por despojo às nações, e te arrancarei dentre os povos, e te destruirei dentre os países, e de todo acabarei contigo; e saberás que eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: For this cause my hand has been stretched out against you, and I will give up your goods to be taken by the nations; I will have you cut off from the peoples and will put an end to you among the countries: I will give you up to destruction; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Visto como dizem em Moabe. e Seir: Eis que a casa de Judá é como todas as nações;
verses.en_web: “‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations;’
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: Because Moab and Seir are saying, See, the people of Judah are like all the nations;

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.pt: portanto, eis que eu abrirei o lado de Moabe desde as cidades, desde as suas cidades que estão pela banda das fronteiras, a glória do país, Bete-Jesimote, Baal-Meom, e até Quiriataim,
verses.en_web: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.en_bbe: For this cause, I will let the side of Moab be uncovered, and his towns on every side, the glory of the land, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and as far as Kiriathaim.

verses.en: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.pt: e ao povo do Oriente, juntamente com os filhos de Amom, eu o entregarei em possessão, para que não haja mais memória dos filhos de Amom entre as nações.
verses.en_web: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.en_bbe: To the children of the east I have given her for a heritage, as well as the children of Ammon, so that there may be no memory of her among the nations:

verses.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Também executarei juízos contra Moabe; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will be the judge of Moab; and they will see that I am the Lord.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Pois que Edom se houve vingativamente para com a casa de Judá, e se fez culpadíssimo, vingando-se deles.
verses.en_web: “‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them;”
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: Because Edom has taken his payment from the people of Judah, and has done great wrong in taking payment from them;

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
verses.pt: portanto assim diz o Senhor Deus: Também estenderei a minha mão contra Edom, e arrancarei dele homens e animais; e o tornarei em deserto desde Temã; e cairão à espada até Dedã.
verses.en_web: therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has said, My hand will be stretched out against Edom, cutting off from it man and beast: and I will make it waste, from Teman even as far as Dedan they will be put to the sword.

verses.en: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: E exercerei a minha vingança sobre Edom, pela mão do meu povo de Israel; e farão em Edom segundo a minha ira e segundo o meu furor; e conhecerão a minha vingança, diz o Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I will take payment from Edom because of my people Israel; and I will take Edom in hand in my wrath and in my passion: and they will have experience of my reward, says the Lord.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Porquanto os filisteus se houveram vingativamente, e executaram vingança com despeito de coração, para destruírem com perpétua inimizade;
verses.en_web: “‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility;”
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: Because the Philistines have taken payment, with the purpose of causing shame and destruction with unending hate;

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.pt: portanto assim diz o Senhor Deus: Eis que estendo a minha mão contra os filisteus, e arrancarei os quereteus, e destruirei o resto da costa do mar.
verses.en_web: therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has said, See, my hand will be stretched out against the Philistines, cutting off the Cherethites and sending destruction on the rest of the sea-land.

verses.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
verses.pt: E executarei neles grandes vinganças, com furiosos castigos; e saberão que eu sou o Senhor, quando eu tiver exercido a minha vingança sobre eles.
verses.en_web: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And I will take great payment from them with acts of wrath; and they will be certain that I am the Lord when I send my punishment on them.
